subject: Order KM-24811 has not moved for a week
text:
Hello,

I ordered two cast-iron trivets (order KM-24811) on 10 November for delivery to Singapore. The tracking page has shown "In transit" for a week without any change. They are a gift for a dinner on 3 December. If they arrive after that, can I still return them?

Thank you,
Shirin Valecourt
